title: ?-galactosidase activity assay
author: Yuan Yao

steps_raw.instruction: Exponentially growing cells (1 ml) at 37°C in ABTGcasa medium were collected at OD450=0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4 and 0.5
Mix with cold toluene (0.1 ml) and kept on ice immediately

0.2 ml toluene-treated sample was added to 1 ml Z buffer (40 mM NaH2PO4, 60 mM Na2HPO4, 10 mM KCl, 1 mM MgSO4 and 50 mM β-mercaptoethanol, pH 7.0) containing 0.66 mg/ml o-nitrophenyl-β-D-galactopyranoside.
The reaction was performed at 30°C until the color changed to yellow
Stop by addition of 0.5 ml 1 M Na2CO3
The absorbance at OD420 was measured
The β-galactosidase activity was calculated by 1000×OD420/reaction time (min) ×OD450×0.2 ml
